verdict.line: You lose long drawn-out trades where his Mist Walkers and empowered Last Rites autos chip you down, but you win any isolated all-in where W (Path Maker)'s damage reduction and a stacked Q (Ntofo Strikes) pull land clean.

brief.thesis: Yorick's kit runs on auto-attack and pet pressure — Mist Walkers swarming plus Q (Last Rites) empowered autos — that out-sustains K'Sante over a long, drawn-out lane. K'Sante's counter is tempo: W (Path Maker)'s charge-up damage reduction and E (Footwork)'s shield let him win short, isolated skirmishes that Yorick can't out-heal. That split explains the 44.9% overall win rate over 819 games alongside K'Sante's measured solo-kill advantage — this is a lane you win in bursts, not in attrition.

theirWindow.when: W (Dark Procession) wall is up and ready
theirWindow.what: He can drop the wall to block your Footwork dash path or box you in alone with his Mist Walkers — don't initiate a committed trade until you've baited the wall out, or you eat full E (Mourning Mist) and walker damage with no exit.

yourWindow.when: His W just went down (20s at rank 1, falling to 12s by rank 5)
yourWindow.what: This is your all-in window — his only zone/disengage tool is on cooldown. Charge W (Path Maker) to soak his poke, land the stun, and follow with stacked Q (Ntofo Strikes, 3.5s cd) for the pull. You have the solo-kill edge — spend it here.

powerCurve.note: Q pokes trade evenly with Last Rites heal
W online at 3, solo-kill window opens
R Maiden and stacked walkers ramp pressure
R cooldown drops, tank core online

start.why: Dominant start (84.6% pick, 45.2% WR over 805 games) — the extra sustain outlasts his early Q (Last Rites) poke attempts before his walkers are relevant.

boots.why: 79.1% pick, 45.2% WR — flattens the stream of small auto-attack hits from Mist Walkers and his empowered Last Rites autos.

core.why: Punishes the exact thing his kit relies on — repeated auto-attacks from Walkers and Last Rites.
Q (Ntofo Strikes) proc turns into an AoE slow burst, letting you clear walker swarms while sticking to Yorick.
Measured 75% WR over 24 games on this path — reflects damage straight back into his auto-reliant pressure.
Stacking resistances closes out the lane deficit and makes you a teamfight wall once R (All Out) comes online.

situational.when: you're losing extended trades to walker and last rites chip damage
his walkers and maiden snowball out of control in the mid game
you want more value out of all out's self-heal and footwork's shield

runes.keystoneWhy: On-hit sustain that scales with HP keeps you ahead of his walker/Last Rites chip damage across the whole lane, not just in cooldown windows.

summoners.why: Dominant pick at 77.9% (42.9% WR) — Teleport lets you reset side-lane pressure after Yorick's wall forces a reset, and Flash covers your all-in setup or escape when his W boxes you in.

playing.title: Bait the wall before committing
playing.detail: Hover at trade range to see if he drops W (Dark Procession) early. Don't dash into a fixed position until it's confirmed down.

playing.title: Stack Q before the all-in
playing.detail: Land two Ntofo Strikes (Q, 3.5s cd each) to build the pull-shockwave stack, then follow with W (Path Maker) to lock the stun in place.

playing.title: Trade through the W charge
playing.detail: Use the damage reduction during Path Maker's charge-up to absorb his empowered Last Rites auto and walker chip, then release the knockback and stun.

playing.title: Punish walker clumps once Thornmail is up
playing.detail: Standing in a cluster of Mist Walkers after core items reflects their damage back onto Yorick, turning his passive into a liability.

playing.title: Track Mourning Mist's cooldown
playing.detail: E is 12/11/10/9/8s — his main poke and armor-shred tool. Step in to trade right after he throws it, not before.

playing.title: Force isolated skirmishes, not extended fights
playing.detail: Your edge is the solo kill, not the long trade. Pull fights away from his walker swarm and Maiden rather than grinding it out.

playing.title: Use R to break his positioning
playing.detail: All Out (R) knocks him through walls, separating him from his own Dark Procession wall and his walkers. Use it to reset the fight on your terms once it's up (80s cd by rank 3).

brief.patchCaveat: Build, boots, runes, summoners, and all win-rate figures are measured from live games on the current patch (16.19.1). The power-curve timing and trade-pattern reasoning are my own tactical read, not measured data.
